title: Strict Kan enriched models of coherent space valued bimodules
statement: Use the nested universe, quasicategory, coherent functor, simplicial model category and homotopy coherent nerve conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison] and [lem-coef-simplicial-model-coherent-diagrams], and the space category $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}=N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathbf{Kan}_{\mathcal U})$ of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. Let $C$ and $D$ be small infinity-categories and let $H:C^{\mathrm{op}}\times D\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ be a small-space-valued coherent functor. There are Bergner cofibrant locally Kan simplicial categories $A$ and $B$, equivalences $N_{\mathrm{hc}}A\simeq C$ and $N_{\mathrm{hc}}B\simeq D$, and a strict simplicial functor $M:A^{\mathrm{op}}\times B\to\mathsf{sSet}$ whose values are $\mathcal U$-small Kan complexes, together with a coherent equivalence between the coherent nerve $N_{\mathrm{hc}}M:N_{\mathrm{hc}}(A)^{\mathrm{op}}\times N_{\mathrm{hc}}B\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ and $H$ transported along these endpoint equivalences. Under this equivalence the two enriched actions of $A$ and $B$ are the first-variable precomposition and second-variable postcomposition actions of $H$, including their units, composition simplices, and all higher coherences. The choices are natural in $H$, in endpoint functors, and in additional small simplicial parameters.

source.place: Theorem 2.2.1.2, Corollary 2.2.5.6 (rigidification of products), Theorem 2.2.5.1 and Proposition 4.2.4.4 with Appendix A.3.3, combined with the Bergner model structure and the enriched diagram presentation; this two-variable strictification is an agent-formulated consequence. Archival copy WANTED.
